EmailTemplate.description: This email template is sent to the customers for acknowledging that their case has been created in the system for Brazil
EmailTemplate.name: BR - Service Connect Lightning Email Template
EmailTemplate.subject: Case created with VFS Service Team, Case Number: {!Case.CaseNumber}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for contacting our Service Team at Volvo Financial Services.
Your case number is: {!Case.CaseNumber} : {!Case.Subject}
We will aim to respond to your enquiry within 48 working hours.
Please note our opening hours are 08:30 – 16:30 Monday to Friday (excluding bank holidays)
